component: Parsed message author field static mapping concern

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical mail_parser MessageHeaders.author implementation reads to() before sender(), although its trait says From then Sender. The relocated accepted trait still has this mismatch. This is a verified static mapping concern, not a reproduced wrong-author result. Current file creation uses ParseRawMailHeaders in C++, and a scoped current Rust search found no outside call of populate_from_message_headers. A mapping review should use different From, To and Sender inputs, then check the actual active consumer before proposing a repair.
title: Check the header getter against the documented sender field
